typography.instructions: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all headings. Use Satoshi for body text. Headings must have tight tracking (`tracking-tight` or `tracking-tighter`). Overlines/labels must be small, uppercase, and have wide tracking (`tracking-[0.2em]`). DO NOT use Inter or Roboto.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Utilize wide margins and ample padding to allow products to breathe. A high-end luxury feel comes from negative space, not crowded elements.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 md:gap-8
spacing_and_layout.instructions: Use grid layouts extensively. For categories, use an asymmetrical bento grid. Images should fill the height of their containers (`object-cover`). Never crowd text. Mobile layout must be flawless as primary traffic is TikTok/IG.

buttons.style: Squared or slightly rounded (`rounded-sm`). Solid background, contrasting text.
buttons.hover: Subtle transform (`-translate-y-[2px]`) and opacity shift or background darkening. Must have explicit hover text color.
buttons.classes: inline-flex items-center justify-center px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all duration-300 ease-out focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2

cards.style: Minimalist. No heavy drop shadows. Use a subtle 1px border (`border-border`) and pure background.
cards.hover: Image zoom effect on hover (`group-hover:scale-105`), subtle lifting of the card.

navigation.style: Sticky header (`sticky top-0 z-50`), glassmorphism effect (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80`).
navigation.features: Must include Dark Mode toggle, Search bar, and clean links.

product_card.layout: Image at top (aspect ratio 4:5 or 1:1), followed by Title, Short Persuasive Desc, Star Rating, Prices (Original crossed out + Discounted), and 'Shop Now' CTA.
product_card.interactions: Hover reveals secondary image or slight zoom. CTA must be highly visible.

visual_enhancers.motion: Smooth, deliberate animations. Fade in on scroll (`framer-motion`), slow image scale on hover. Nothing erratic.
visual_enhancers.textures: Clean, solid colors. In dark mode, use subtle differences in background lightness (`#121212` vs `#1A1A1A`) instead of borders to separate sections where possible.
visual_enhancers.badges: Use small, high-contrast badges for 'Best Seller', 'Viral', '20% OFF' placed in the top-left of product images.

hero_section.description: Premium living room for main hero background

testing.attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, form submissions, navigation items, toggle switches, product cards) MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `@phosphor-icons/react` or `lucide-react` for clean, high-end iconography.
Implement a comprehensive dark mode toggle that respects the color palette exactly as defined. Do NOT use default Tailwind grays. Use the specified custom colors.
Build a countdown timer for the 'Daily Deals' section. It should look sleek, not spammy.

For the Bento Grid categories (Smart Home, Kitchen, Decor, Organization, TikTok Finds, Fashion), use the provided category images with a subtle gradient overlay so text remains readable (e.g., `bg-black/30`).

Product Cards must have a high-converting layout: Image (aspect-square or 4:5), Category overline, Product Title, Short description, Star rating with count, Old price (line-through), New price, and a solid CTA button 'Shop Now'. Include a 'data-testid' on every button.
Ensure the hero section is visually striking with large typography (`Cabinet Grotesk`), asymmetrical layout, and high-quality imagery.
Include an Affiliate Disclosure in the footer and a subtle disclaimer near the top or in the About section.
Do NOT use raw HTML `<select>` or `<input type="date">`. Use Shadcn if needed, but for an ecommerce site, stick to clean custom UI for product selection if variants exist.
Add a Newsletter Signup popup or section with a sleek, minimalist design.
Implement smooth scrolling using Lenis if possible, or standard smooth scroll behavior.
Mobile layout must be prioritized. Buttons should be large enough to tap easily (min 44px height). Padding on mobile should be generous but not waste screen space.
